items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: When I went to, when I went to Grunewald... I have a lot of stuff that I... from Grunewald that I had.

ctx.x: you were coming up, or when you... Well, no. When I went to, when I went to

Grunewald, it was, it was, man, guys was hanging around with pencils in their bag pocket, and all they wanted to do was sign in the paper, just to get the money. But I went to line. I went and got as much as I could out of the year and six months I think it was that I had over there. About eighteen months that I had over there. I got as much as I could out of that. But the actual play and the actual do things over there, it never happened.
